behavior_contracts.A3.2/wrap-decl: wrap name from base with one fetch/judge/wrapper base, mandatory emits calculated, attached asserts and handles native/emitted tables. Signature, grouped state, connection and callable eligibility inherit from the root; grammar admits no inputs/connection/signature clause.
behavior_contracts.A3.2/policy-keys: Keys are (origin, exact error specialization) against the original N/E boundary sets. Bare generic names resolve only with exactly one concrete specialization in E (C5.1); raw native keys compare declarations.
behavior_contracts.A3.2/calculated-bound: Finite public bound = union of effective-rule escapes with per-member provenance (handler + inherit chain). Explicit-bound callees are leaves; base/callable wrapper dependencies order the policy pass; bound cycles fail.
behavior_contracts.A3.2/inherit: Terminal-only inherit delegates to the nearest base holder rule or the origin default (normalized forward for native, unchanged for emitted). Handler failures escape without redispatch.
behavior_contracts.A3.2/injection: Attached using failure native|emitted rows skip the wrapped operation and start policy lookup from a fresh origin-tagged occurrence. Injection validates against the original boundary (replaced keys stay injectable); standard failures and cross-origin values reject; reported as policy-fixture, never request evidence.
behavior_contracts.A3.2/coverage: Every locally declared key must be selected by an attached row (injection or raw failure outcome through normalization). Missing local-key coverage fails the build.
